name: DeepSearchQA
intro: DeepSearchQA是一个包含900个提示的基准测试，旨在评估智能体在17个不同领域中执行复杂多步信息检索任务的能力。该基准通过精心设计的手工任务，测试智能体系统性整理碎片信息、去重与实体解析以及在开放式搜索空间中判断停止标准的能力。所有任务均基于开放网络，并具有客观可验证的答案集。对现有智能体架构的评估显示，即使是最先进的模型也难以在高召回率和精确度之间取得平衡，揭示了当前智能体设计在深度研究能力方面的显著局限性。
build_method: 专家构建, 客观真值过滤, 时间锚定
metric: F1（主指标）, 精确率, 召回率, 四类结果占比
eval_feature: 黑盒结果评测, 单答案与答案集, 因果搜索链, 停止与撒网失败分析
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Definitive-ground-truth Filtering, Time Anchoring
eval_feature_en: Black-box Outcome Evaluation, Single/Set Answers, Causal Search Chains, Stopping and Hedging Analysis
intro_en: DeepSearchQA is a benchmark consisting of 900 prompts designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform complex multi-step information retrieval tasks across 17 different domains. The benchmark uses carefully crafted manual tasks to test agents' capabilities in systematically organizing fragmented information, deduplication and entity resolution, as well as determining stopping criteria in an open search space. All tasks are based on the open web and have objectively verifiable answer sets. Evaluations of existing agent architectures show that even state-of-the-art models struggle to balance high recall and precision, revealing significant limitations in current agent designs for deep research capabilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.20975, especially Sections 2-3 and Tables 2-3. Expert annotators curate 900 difficult information-seeking prompts across 17 fields and retain objective tasks with definitive single-answer or exhaustive-set ground truth. Prompts are time-anchored or tied to static sources to reduce live-web drift. Tasks form causal chains that test structured retrieval, context assembly, logical reasoning, deduplication, entity resolution, and stopping criteria. Agents are treated as black boxes and submit distinct answer sets. Continuous evaluation reports precision, recall, and primary F1; categorical evaluation distinguishes fully correct, fully incorrect, partially correct, and correct-with-extraneous-answer outcomes to expose premature stopping and hedging.
